description.value: PETPLS is a pet food and supply store in Richmond's Number 3 Road commercial corridor, offering a curated selection of high-quality pet foods and supplies for cats and dogs sourced from Canada, Korea, Germany, Italy, and New Zealand. The store features a bookable cat room where visitors can interact with adoptable rescue cats, and also offers cat boarding services. Located beside a SkyTrain station, it is an accessible stop for cyclists traveling with animal companions.
